senses.gloss:
Ved. 
__1 A protector; ओमासश्चर्षणीधृतो [[Rv. 1. 3. 7.]] 
__2 One who is favourably disposed (towards another) 
__3 Any one fit to be protected or favoured.

m. 
__1 Protection. 
__2 Favour, kindness. 
__3 A kind person. 
-ना A friend, helper, protector; परि घ्रंसमोमना वां वयो गात् [[Rv. 7. 69. 4.]]

a. 
__1 Friendly; helping, useful; ओमन्वन्तं चकथुः सप्तबध्रये [[Rv. 10. 39. 9.]] 
__2 Favourable, kind. 
__3 Satiating, pleasing.
Protection, kindness, assistance; महीं त ओमात्रां कृष्टयो विदुः [[Rv. 10. 50. 5.]]
